title: Chapter 7 Biological Colonization Equipment
content:
Chapter 7 Biological Colonization Equipment

At dawn, when the first ray of morning light illuminated the earth, the strange sound that had been tossing in Wu Qing's ears all night finally disappeared.

This night, he was tortured a lot.

Wu Qing walked out of the mother nest, stretched his body, and felt that the whole world had returned to normal. Compared with last night, it seemed like two different worlds.

"What was the weird thing last night? Where is it now?"

With his knowledge, he was confused for a while.

"This world is too strange, very abnormal!"

Wu Qing came from the time travel. Although he could understand the language of this world, he had not spoken a word to the people of this world, and he knew nothing about the situation here.

Without understanding the situation, based on the strange things he saw, there was too little useful information to be obtained.

"Weak monsters or orcs? Fanatical believers of green skins? Weird and dangerous strange existence?"

"Forget it, don't think about it. The root of everything is to strengthen yourself."

Wu Qing, who was confused, stopped entangled with these questions.

After a night of development, the Zerg territory has expanded a lot. Now everything is quiet here, and other creatures dare not approach the Zerg territory.

After a night of accumulation, the number of puppies reached 200, plus 30 hydralisks, which is a strong force.

Wu Qing waved his hand and scattered 100 puppies to explore in all directions.

Today's main task is to understand the surrounding situation and deal with the possible attack of the greenskins.

Considering the strange situation that will appear at night, Wu Qing will build another sub-base, which is very unfavorable for defense. He built a mother nest every distance along the Zerg territory towards the valley entrance.

When he built the third mother nest, he stopped. If he continued to build, the resources would not keep up.

Each newly built mother nest hatches five worker bees for mining, and the main base supplements 20 worker bees. At this time, the total number of worker bees has reached 35, and the mother nest has increased to 8.

It won't take much time for these mother nests to be connected into one piece through organic spread, and the area of the entire Zerg territory will be greatly increased.

The remaining energy is to produce puppies all the time, and no resources can be kept.

Wu Qing took care of the Zerg territory, and the puppies who went out to explore the situation brought some news.

The puppies are very fast, and they have already explored the situation around the Zerg territory.

This is at the foot of a mountain, with dense vegetation and complex terrain. Several valleys and cliffs have been found in the surrounding area.

I don’t know if it’s because of the weird haunting at night, the puppies have not encountered threatening creatures for the time being.

"The puppy that suddenly lost contact last night should be caused by a weird attack."

Wu Qing remembered the only puppy that was attacked and lost contact outside the territory yesterday.

The puppies continued to explore outside and found that outside the mountains was the plain area where the greenskins were stationed.

"There is another side, the camp I was in when I first landed, but I haven’t found it yet."

Wu Qing ordered the puppies to continue exploring. He habitually began to practice body refining, which is the most basic and important practice method in the system practice system.

Body refining can effectively develop human potential and improve the body’s control over various powers.

After a set of body-refining techniques, Wu Qing felt refreshed. He looked at the iron gun beside him and felt a little disgusted with such a weapon.

Zergs are experts in playing with genes. All their scientific research is aimed at their own improvement and genetic modification, and they never need to rely on external objects.

Zergs have no tools or weapons. Their bodies are tools and weapons. They don’t know how to forge iron, so they can’t even help Wu Qing make an iron gun.

This is not very friendly to Wu Qing.

Wu Qing thought about it, and suddenly a light bulb went off in his head. He thought of a research project on biological reproductive weapons in the institute.

It was a project he personally approved at the time, but because the genetic technology did not meet the requirements, the project has not made a breakthrough.

However, many design ideas and concepts of this project inspired Wu Qing.

"It used to be that the technology was not good, but now there is no shortage of technology, so we can give it a try."

Wu Qing did what he thought of, and he communicated with the collective consciousness of the Zerg.

"Although you are collective wisdom, you are also an intelligent creature. Give you a name."

"Well, Kerrigan is the Queen of Blades, and you are not the same thing. This name cannot be used for you."

"It is really difficult for me to name you. I will just call you the Queen of Zerg."

Wu Qing had a headache when he thought of naming. The people who followed him in that world were either Wu Yi, Wu Zhan, or Wu Gong. You can imagine his naming skills.

Wu Qing himself is part of the collective consciousness of the Zerg, and he is also the master of this consciousness. Of course, there will be no objection to the name he gave.

He told the Queen of Zerg about his design ideas for biological colonization suits, and the Queen of Zerg quickly designed a feasible plan based on the existing genetic technology of the Zerg.

Wu Qing did not understand the advanced technology of genes, but the process was not important. He only needed to look at the results.

Select a larva, activate the genetic code required for the production of biological colonization suits, and the biological colonization suits will evolve corresponding functions according to the amount of energy and gas provided.

For the first production, Wu Qing chose to consume 100 energy points and 50 gas points.

The larvae transform into pupae, and after a short period of gestation, a black hard ball the size of a boxer breaks out of the pupae.

Wu Qing picked up the black ball and didn't feel much weight. He learned about the biological reproductive suit from the Queen.

The biological reproductive suit is a special unit of the Zerg. It also has life and instincts. It occupies one-fifth of the population limit and is controlled by Wu Qing and the Queen.

It can be bound to people or other creatures and become part of their bodies.

It can quickly proliferate and change into a variety of armor weapons, and can also evolve by absorbing various energies.

Wu Qing is one with the Zerg, and there is no need to bind. With a thought, the black ball in his hand proliferated and changed rapidly. According to Wu Qing's wishes, he was instantly covered with a layer of full-body black armor, and a solid and sharp black spear appeared in his hand.

"The armor is comfortable inside, hard outside, and has good defensive capabilities."

"The strength, toughness and sharpness of the weapon are all very good. It is a perfect creation!"

Wu Qing knocked on the armor, tried the weapon, and sighed.

He didn't expect that the thing that the institute had been studying for so long was made by the Queen of Zerg with just one thought, which was better than he had originally imagined.

With this magical biological colonization suit, Wu Qing had some ideas about creatures other than the Zerg.

After all, the Zerg cannot live independently and need to interact with the outside world.

"Hoohoohoo...!"

Wu Qing's gun skills were so powerful that he hadn't practiced such basic skills for a long time. It seemed as if he had returned to the days when he had just crossed over to another world and was training hard.
